title: Applied Computing wants to give oil and gas operators an AI model for the entire plant
slides: Can one AI model truly run your entire plant?
Most operators today rely on dozens of disconnected tools.
Applied Computing built a single model for the whole facility.
Engineers can now see and control every unit from one view.
Test it on one process before rolling out plant-wide.
thread_text:
1. One model to rule them all?

Today's plants juggle dozens of disconnected tools — one team spent months just syncing data between two dashboards.

2. Single AI, entire facility.

Applied Computing trained one model on every unit — no more separate systems for boilers, compressors, or reactors.

3. See everything from one view.

Engineers now monitor and adjust any part of the plant on a single screen — no context switching needed.

4. Test before you scale.

Run the model on one process first. If it works, roll it out plant-wide — no all-or-nothing risk.

5. Start with one stubborn unit.

Pick a process that gives you headaches. Test this unified model on it this week — or prove it can't handle your worst bottleneck.
